title: [TRACKER] Foveated rendering on Vulkan with fragment density maps
body:
This is a TRACKER issue to help facilitate communication between the different parties collaborating on implementing this, primarily with regard to some hardware/driver specific issues we're attempting to debug.

## Current PRs

- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99551
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99768

## Current Issues

### Crash on devices with Qualcomm's Snapdragon XR2 Gen1

Godot [PR 99551](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99551) adds support for using `VK_EXT_fragment_density_map`, with a manually generated density map. This seems to work great on Quest 3!

However, when running on any device using Qualcomm's Snapdragon XR2 Gen1 (we've tested Quest 2, Quest Pro, HTC Vive XR Elite and Pico 4) it will crash with a null pointer dereference within the Vulkan driver (see below for the backtrace).

Godot [PR 99768](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99768) builds on PR 99551 to get the density map from `XR_FB_foveation_vulkan`. However, this one works fine on Quest 3, Quest Pro and Quest 2.

So, there seems to be something about the way that Godot manually generates the density map in PR 99551 that leads to this crash.

Unfortunately, we’ve been unable to narrow down what it is that we are doing wrong. We’ve tried looking at messages from the Vulkan validation layers, as well as tried numerous arbitrary changes, but no luck so far.
